title: Deva
desc: Deva and Bharathi are in love and plan on getting married until her father opposes their relationship. Can Deva prove himself to be a worthy suitor?

title: Aatha Naan Pass Ayittaen
desc: Sita, a village officer, tries to expose the atrocities of an evil leader. When he tries to defame her, her lover comes to her rescue and marries her in front of the village.

title: Aboorva Nagam
desc: Annapoorni gives birth to a son who transforms into a snake in the evening. He falls in love with Meenakshi and marries her while she is unaware of his special ability.

title: Engeyo Ketta Kural
desc: Ponni wants to live a lavish life but gets married to her cousin Kumaran. Her love for worldly pleasures makes her abandon Kumaran and her daughter for a richer man.

title: Parambarai
desc: Paramasivan has a rocky relationship with his father following the tragic murder of his mother. To make matters more complicated, he falls in love with the daughter of a ruthless landlord.
